tokens.name: ground-sunken
tokens.usage: The well: Terminal bodies, code, the footer, the darkest end of a Sleeve grade. Deeper than the page, never used for cards.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. Night is the John Wick grade (cold blue-grey, hue 245); Paper is bone map paper (hue 85). Every other neutral is this hue at another value.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Folio leaves, the current Masthead cell, the Dial hub, menus. One step up from ground; lit from above by keylight, never lifted by a shadow.

tokens.name: slab
tokens.usage: Concrete mass: big brutalist blocks, the Sleeve caption band, Terminal title bar, ghost Button hover. Use in large areas or not at all.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative lines only: Terrain grid, Masthead cell rules and strip, the inner rule of a Folio, Button inner rules at rest. Deliberately below 3:1 (1.4:1 night on ground); never the only edge of something a person must find.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must be seen: ghost Button and Folio frames, Tag spine, the Masthead neatline, Dial rings. Holds 3.2:1 (night) and 3.0:1 (paper) or better on all four grounds.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings, the name. Night ink is pale steel, not white. Holds 12.6:1 (night) and 11.8:1 (paper) or better on ground-sunken, ground, ground-raised and slab.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: Folio summaries, legend labels, nav labels at rest, Contact links, Terminal output, Dial majors. Holds 7.0:1 (night) and 5.8:1 (paper) or better on ground-sunken, ground, ground-raised and slab.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: coordinates, grid refs, scale ticks, placeholders, captions, hatch lines. Not on accent-dim. Holds 4.5:1 (night) and 4.5:1 (paper) or better on ground-sunken, ground, ground-raised and slab.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one signal: links, primary Button fill, focus, $ prompts, live Status, current nav item. Night is Catppuccin Mocha Sapphire exactly; Paper deepens the same hue (Latte's own #209fb5 is only 2.5:1 on paper). As text it holds 8.6:1 (night) and 4.8:1 (paper) or better on all four grounds. Never decoration, never a block of body text.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: Selection and highlight behind ink text (10.8:1 night, 12.2:1 paper). Not a surface for cards.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent fill (primary Button label): 10.3:1 night, 5.9:1 paper.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Vermilion, the one warm colour left: error text only (a failed copy), always with words. On ground and ground-raised (5.4:1 night, 4.7:1 paper). Never identity, never decoration.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The live Status glyph (●) and anything that means "on now". Always beside a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid outline, 3px offset, square. At least 8.6:1 (night) and 4.8:1 (paper) against every ground.

tokens.name: redact
tokens.usage: Redaction bars. The bar is the ink colour, so hidden text is exactly as loud as the text around it.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: The ::selection background, with ink text.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: East: the ashy ink of contours and brush strokes. Decorative only, never text, never the only edge of anything.

tokens.name: wash
tokens.usage: Ink wash: the blurred mist on Terrain. An alpha tint; never a surface for text.

tokens.name: keylight
tokens.usage: Top light (Gordon Willis): the start colour of a to-bottom gradient that fades to transparent by 40%, over ground-raised surfaces. Never a glow, never on text.

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: Hero edges only: a radial gradient from transparent at 55% to this at 100%. Night is black; Paper is sepia, the Godfather print.

tokens.name: duotone-shadow
tokens.usage: Sleeve grade: where a photo is black.

tokens.name: duotone-light
tokens.usage: Sleeve "steel" grade: where a photo is white. Night reads as the pale-blue John Wick grade.

tokens.name: duotone-tint
tokens.usage: Sleeve "sapphire" grade: where a photo is white. The Blue Note sleeve: one colour and black. Dawn and dusk shots.

families.ui: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Once per page: the name on the hero. Bodoni Moda at opsz 96. clamp(64px, 12vw, 120px). Never a sentence.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Cinematic scale: the giant cropped Sheet numbers, in line or ink, always cropped by a frame. 36px inside a Folio dial hub.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Sleeve titles and one closing line. Two to four words. Leave font-optical-sizing on auto below 96px.

styles.name: sheet
styles.usage: Section titles (Sheet). Martian Mono at wdth 112.5, uppercase: the thick, boxy Western map title. 28px under 560px.

styles.name: folio
styles.usage: Folio titles, wdth 112.5, in the case the project uses; 24px in narrow containers.

styles.name: mark
styles.usage: Buttons, nav labels, legend heads: wdth 112.5, uppercase, no tracking. Width does the work letter-spacing used to.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Full-stack & cloud engineer. I automate what shouldn't need me.
styles.usage: Hero lead and section intros; max measure-lead.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ten years of .NET, one strangler fig, zero downtime.

styles.name: annotation
styles.usage: The narrator, as a map annotation: italic, in parentheses, ink-muted, at most one per section.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminal, Log and inline code, on ground-sunken.

styles.name: coord
styles.usage: Coordinates, grid refs, scale, sheet refs, captions, hints. ink-faint. Tabular numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: glyph to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag gaps, the ref line under a Sheet number.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to glyph inside Buttons; legend column gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Terminal body padding; Sleeve caption padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Folio padding and column gap, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between a Sheet and the section it opens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile; above and below a Divider.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top air on desktop. Silence is part of the grade.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything that is not scooped. No convex rounding anywhere.

tokens.name: scoop-sm
tokens.usage: Concave (scooped) corner radius: small Buttons. Scoops, never rounds: the corner is cut inward like a cartouche or a Chinese window frame.

tokens.name: scoop-md
tokens.usage: Scooped corners: Buttons.

tokens.name: scoop-lg
tokens.usage: Scooped corners: Folio leaves.

shadow.note: No drop shadows. Depth is value steps plus light from above.

tokens.name: edge-top
tokens.usage: The 1px top edge caught by the key light on raised surfaces and slabs.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: The only elevation shadow there is.

cut.note: Chamfer sizes for the top-right cut corner (Terminal), applied with the .nn-cut utility. Buttons and Folios use scooped corners instead.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: The default .nn-cut chamfer.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Terminal.

stroke.note: Line weights. East is hair and ink; West is box and slab.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Contours, hairline rules, Folio and Button inner rules.

tokens.name: stroke-ink
tokens.usage: Index contours (every fifth line).

tokens.name: stroke-box
tokens.usage: West: Legend head, Masthead neatline and nav cells, scale bar, Tag spine.

tokens.name: stroke-slab
tokens.usage: West, heaviest: the rule a Sheet hangs from.

decay.note: Digital decay: how far plates and ghosts drift.

tokens.name: decay-shift
tokens.usage: The Sheet numeral outline drifts 2x this off-register.

tokens.name: decay-ghost
tokens.usage: The 2-frame ghost copies on hover.

measure.note: Line lengths in ch of the element's own font.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Body copy.

tokens.name: measure-lead
tokens.usage: Lead text.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: Terminal and Log blocks.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the 12-column page grid (24px gutters).

tokens.name: grain-night
tokens.usage: Grain strength in Night, blended hard-light (overlay and soft-light vanish on near-black). Soft is 0.6x, heavy 1.6x.

tokens.name: grain-paper
tokens.usage: Grain strength in Paper, blended multiply: paper fibre. Soft is 0.6x, heavy 1.6x.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

duration.note: Motion runs on frames: hard cuts for state, steps() for travel.

tokens.name: dur-cut
tokens.usage: Hover and active state changes. A cut, not a fade; the 2-frame ghost rides on top (120ms).

tokens.name: dur-snap
tokens.usage: Press, the arrow nudge.

tokens.name: dur-dissolve
tokens.usage: Overlays only (menus, dialogs, lightbox): opacity.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Uncharted hatch clearing; swash underlines drawing in; the Folio needle turning (1.2x, six ticks); the Sheet brush drawing (2x).

tokens.name: dur-sign
tokens.usage: The Signature brushing in, top to bottom, in ten frames: once per page load.

tokens.name: dur-grain
tokens.usage: One loop of the hero grain: five frames, about 12 fps.

tokens.name: dur-blink
tokens.usage: Caret and live-dot blink.

tokens.name: ease-cut
tokens.usage: Hard cuts; the grain frames.

tokens.name: ease-frames
tokens.usage: Travel that should feel shot on twos: hatch clearing, route drawing.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Dissolves.

tokens.name: z-mast
tokens.usage: Sticky Masthead.

tokens.name: z-grain
tokens.usage: Page-level Grain overlay (pointer-events: none).
